# Shh Aesthetics & Wellness
 
> Mobile, nurse practitioner-led aesthetics and wellness clinic in Southwest Florida. Kelly, a licensed nurse practitioner, provides natural-looking Botox, dermal fillers, skin care and wellness treatments at clients' homes across Lee, Charlotte and Collier counties. Consultations are free.
 
## Key facts
 
- Business name: Shh Aesthetics & Wellness (legal name: SHH AESTHETICS AND WELLNESS LLC)
- Tagline: Beauty is our little secret
- Provider: Kelly, licensed nurse practitioner (NP). Kelly performs every treatment.
- Model: Mobile clinic. Kelly travels to the client's home; there is no office or waiting room.
- Service area: Lee, Charlotte and Collier counties, Florida, including Cape Coral, Fort Myers, Naples, Bonita Springs, Estero, Lehigh Acres, Sanibel, Marco Island, Punta Gorda and Port Charlotte.
- Consultation: Free, at the client's home.
- Appointment length: Usually 1 to 2 hours, sometimes longer depending on the treatment.
- Approach: Conservative, natural-looking results ("results nobody can quite point to"). No upselling.
 
## Treatments
 
- Injectables: Botox and Dysport, dermal fillers, lip enhancement, jawline contouring
- Skin care: peptide therapy, custom home skin care regimens
- Wellness: medically guided weight management, with regular reviews
